name: chip-design-mcp
description: Open-source RTL-to-GDSII ASIC automation via FastMCP 3.2 — Yosys, cocotb/iverilog, OpenLane, Magic/netgen/OpenSTA. REST + MCP HTTP on :11022, stdio via python -m chip_design_mcp.server.

env.name: CHIP_DESIGN_MCP_WORK_DIR
env.description: Workspace for uploads, outputs, and OpenLane designs (default: %TEMP%\chip_design_mcp_work)

env.name: CHIP_DESIGN_MCP_PREFAB_APPS
env.description: Register Prefab in-chat cards (1=on, 0=off for headless CI)

tools.name: chip_status
tools.description: EDA tool availability and server status

tools.name: chip_available_pdks
tools.description: Supported open PDKs and install status

tools.name: syn_run
tools.description: Run Yosys synthesis on uploaded RTL

tools.name: depot_init
tools.description: Scaffold a new chip design project
